title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Contents Value Ceiling from a BizFlood Statement of Values
content:
Contents claims note for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): where the named insured's BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) declare a contents value for the insured building's address, that declared value is the ceiling to which the contents loss is held on a contents proof of loss.

**Rule.** The contents value ceiling is settled as follows, the BizFlood policy meant being the named insured's BizFlood policy whose statement of values schedules the building's address, counted only when it was in force on the date of loss: when that BizFlood policy declares a contents value for the address and a value endorsement for that location was in force on the date of loss, it is the contents limit set by that endorsement, the value endorsement in force being, of the value increase and the value decrease endorsed for the location, the one that took effect later among those that took effect on or before the date of loss, an increase and a decrease taking effect the same day being settled by the one recorded later, and by the increase when both were recorded the same day; when that BizFlood policy declares a contents value for the address and no value endorsement for that location was in force on the date of loss, it is the contents value on its statement of values; otherwise it is the contents limit.

**Terms.** The building's location on that BizFlood policy is the location number its statement of values gives the building's address. That BizFlood policy is in force on the date of loss when the date of loss falls on or after its effective date, before its term end and before any cancellation effective date it carries. The BizFlood readings above are used only where the named insured's BizFlood statements of values schedule the building's address at most once and that BizFlood policy holds at most one value increase and at most one value decrease for the address; otherwise the contents value ceiling is the contents limit.

## Records read

On the BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines): the statement of values entry for the address (its contents value), the value increase and value decrease endorsements for the address (effective date, recorded date, contents limit), and the policy's effective date, term end and any cancellation effective date.

## Ladder

| BizFlood records | Contents value ceiling |
|---|---|
| Address on one statement of values; policy in force on the date of loss; contents value declared; a value endorsement in force on the date of loss | the contents limit set by that endorsement |
| Same, no value endorsement in force on the date of loss | the contents value on the statement of values |
| No contents value declared, policy not in force on the date of loss, or no statement of values for the address | this policy's contents limit |
| Address on more than one statement of values, or more than one value increase or value decrease for it | this policy's contents limit |

## Endorsement-in-force cases (hypothetical; date of loss 15 June)

- Value decrease effective 1 March, value increase effective 1 May: the increase.
- Both effective 1 May; the decrease recorded 3 May, the increase 2 May: the decrease.
- Both effective 1 May and both recorded 2 May: the increase.
- An increase effective 20 June: not in force on the date of loss.
